io.mavlink4j.config

Packages that use io.mavlink4j.config
Package
Description
io.mavlink4j.codec
L2 — bytes to Frame and back, plus MAVLink 2 signing.
io.mavlink4j.config
Tunables (MavlinkSettings): timeouts, retries, clock, thread factory and callback executor.
io.mavlink4j.service
L4 — one class per MAVLink microservice (command, parameter, heartbeat, manual control, message interval, capability).
io.mavlink4j.session
L3 — the MavlinkSession composition root: reader threads, peer directory, dispatcher, correlator, TX scheduler.
  • Classes in io.mavlink4j.config used by io.mavlink4j.codec
    Class
    Description
    MavlinkSettings
    Every value the MAVLink spec itself declines to pin (heartbeat rate, peer timeout, command retry policy, ...), the module's own internal bounds (resync buffer cap, dispatch queue capacity, poll interval, scheduler pool size) and the three runtime collaborators the library must never hard-wire: the clock, the thread factory and the executor completions are delivered on.
  • Classes in io.mavlink4j.config used by io.mavlink4j.config
    Class
    Description
    MavlinkSettings
    Every value the MAVLink spec itself declines to pin (heartbeat rate, peer timeout, command retry policy, ...), the module's own internal bounds (resync buffer cap, dispatch queue capacity, poll interval, scheduler pool size) and the three runtime collaborators the library must never hard-wire: the clock, the thread factory and the executor completions are delivered on.
    MavlinkSettings.Builder
    Mutable, single-use staging area for a MavlinkSettings; validation happens in MavlinkSettings.Builder.build().
    MavlinkSettings.LinkHealth
    DefaultLinkHealth's drop-rate accounting: loss is measured over the trailing window only (a restart or a second sender must not haunt the rate forever), and a wrapped seq gap larger than resyncGap is a sender restart / second source, not that many lost frames -- it is counted as one resync and adds no loss.
    MavlinkSettings.Parameter
    Parameter read/write timing.
    MavlinkSettings.PeerSettings
    Address-flap detection in the peer directory: a peer heard from two addresses on one link within flapWindow is flagged, and the warning for one peer is repeated at most once per warnInterval so a genuine roam cannot flood the log.
    MavlinkSettings.Rc
    The fixed-rate RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE relay's cadence.
    MavlinkSettings.SigningSettings
    Pure numeric signing tuning -- windows, a tolerance, a bound.
